Spacious & Versatile Home in a Prime San Francisco Location

Welcome to 559 Brunswick St, a charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home with 1,876 sq. ft. of living space in the vibrant Crocker Amazon neighborhood. With its generous layout and unbeatable location, this home wont stay on the market for long!

The upper level features three well-sized bedrooms, including a primary suite, while the lower level offers a separate one-bedroom in-law unit perfect for extended family, guests, or rental income. With a little TLC, this home can truly shine and become your dream home.

Step outside to a private backyard, ideal for relaxing, gardening, or hosting get-togethers. The spacious two-car garage and additional storage ensure plenty of room for all your needs.

This home is just minutes from BART, Muni, Highway 280 & 101, as well as shopping, dining, and parks making both commuting and exploring the city effortless.

Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity!
